verdict.rationale: The README documents a promptless install path: installing all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi "without prompts". It also offers a flag-driven single-skill install (`--skill wiki-yylo`) and an explicit `yy skills install` command, all of which an agent could run headlessly. missing for 10: the exact non-interactive command and flags behind the "without prompts" path are not quoted in the evidence, and there is no hands-on or independent confirmation of an unattended end-to-end agent install.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end

citations.quote: Install all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts
Run `yy skills install` or `yy skills update` explicitly to select the latest compatible stable release and update all three agent copies.
